name: Rental Kareshi
source:
A first-timer in love and romance, you suddenly end up one day working for a "boyfriend consignation" company!

"Kissing... is an option?"
In a world well beyong your imagination, comes a bewildered you.
Surrounded by all these good-looking and well-seasoned men,
your daily excitement just never ends!

Enjoy a romance like no other!

[From the [url=http://okko.jp/otome/sweetromance.en/game9.html]official website[/url]]
